name: Siddique ul-Islam (Bangla Bhai)
contribution: Known as Bangla Bhai, he became a prominent militant organizer in northwestern Bangladesh and was executed in 2007 after conviction in the Jhalakathi judges murder case.
context: The rise of militant groups including JMJB and JMB in Bangladesh during the early and mid-2000s.
impact: His activities made militant violence in the northwest a national security issue and became closely linked to public memory of the 2005 bombing wave.

faq.question: Why is Bangla Bhai significant?
faq.answer: He became one of the most visible militant figures of the mid-2000s, associated with JMJB/JMB activity in northwestern Bangladesh and later with prosecutions after the 2005 bombing wave.
